# linkedin-release-post — runbook

1. Read `package.json` name/version, README highlights, latest GitHub release notes / CHANGELOG.
2. Confirm version is actually on npm (`npm view … version`) before “available on npm” wording.
3. Ask operator for language (EN/DE) and any must-mention partners or demos.
4. Generate main + short posts per `SKILL.md`.
5. Hand off for human edit and manual LinkedIn publish — no API posting.
